title: {Syn} Carmichael Numbers Fool Fermat Tests
content:
Carmichael numbers are composite numbers that pass Fermat primality tests for every base coprime to them. The smallest is 561, which equals 3 times 11 times 17.

They are a reminder that a theorem can inspire a useful test while still leaving edge cases that demand sharper tools.

Why it matters: number theory keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
